validate_environment: validate environment headers with Perplexity API key and return configured headers dict
get_complete_url: get the complete Perplexity search endpoint URL from optional api base or default endpoint
transform_search_request: transform a search query and optional params into Perplexity API request format dict
transform_search_response: transform a raw Perplexity HTTP response into a standardized SearchResponse object
build_search_request: build a PerplexitySearchRequest dict with query, max_results, domain filter, and country params
